shortDescription: SSB Constable Tradesman PET/PST Admit Card 2026 is available. PET/PST for the relevant Constable (Non-GD) posts is scheduled from 08 August 2026 to 13 October 2026.
content:
Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released the e-Admit Card for Constable to Sub-Inspector (Non-GD)-2025 PET and PST.

The official SSB Admit Card portal lists several Constable (Non-GD) Tradesman posts, including Constable Carpenter, Waiter, Driver, Gardner, Cobbler, Veterinary, Washerman, Barber, Water Carrier, Nursing Orderly and Tailor. The physical stage is scheduled from 08 August 2026 to 13 October 2026.

Candidates should download their individual e-Admit Card from the official SSB recruitment portal and follow the date, venue, reporting time and instructions printed on the call letter.
